newsitem.title: USA: Cooler weather but no damaging cold seen in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Cooler weather but no damaging cold seen in Brazil.

text.p: Central Brazil's weather is generally favourable for coffee trees and the maturing crop at present but somewhat cooler than normal conditions are expected in the coffee belt this week, private forecaster Weather Services said.
However, no damaging cold is indicated and there are no cold air masses expected to build out of Argentina during the next five to seven days, it added.
Wednesday will be partly cloudy in central Brazil with a few passing light showers and highs of 70-77F (21-25C) and the night will be mostly clear with lows down to 45-55F (7-13C).
Thursday will be mostly sunny with highs of 68-77F (20-25C).
The outlook is for dry weather with near to below normal temperatures on Friday to Sunday but no damaging cold expected.
